name: sanctions-ofac-ofsi-2026
display_name: Sanctions 2026 — OFAC + OFSI + EU + UN cross-jurisdictional
description: Cross-jurisdictional sanctions knowledge graph: the OFAC (US Treasury) framework — IEEPA / TWEA / NEA enabling authorities, the SDN + Non-SDN lists, the 50% Rule, the OFAC Framework for Compliance Commitments (May 2019 — 5 essential elements), the 2024 NDAA statute-of-limitations extension to 10 years, secondary sanctions (EO 14114 Russia + correspondent banking), Tornado-Cash-era crypto sanctions, and ransomware advisories. Plus OFSI (HM Treasury) — SAMLA 2018, the UK Consolidated List, OFSI General Guidance + reporting obligation, the 2025 step-change in enforcement (6 penalties vs 1 in 2024) and the 2025 turnover-based-fines consultation. Plus EU sanctions (Council Regs 269/2014 + 833/2014 Russia framework + CFSP architecture) and UN Security Council baseline regimes (1267 ISIL/Al-Qaida + 1718 DPRK + 2231 Iran). Designed for any institution operating across US / UK / EU sanctions exposure.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
regulation_ids: OFAC Executive Orders (EO 14114 Russia secondary; Tornado Cash; etc.)
